Problem Statement
Given an array of integers and a target value, find the first position of the target using linear search.
Description
Read an array of integers and a target value. Search the array from left to right using linear search. If the target occurs more than once, print the index of its first occurrence. If it is not present, print -1.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers. The third line contains an integer target.
Output Description
Print the 0-based index of the first occurrence of target. If target is not present, print -1.
Sample Input
6
12 7 25 7 30 18
7
Sample Output
1
